answer: An admission auction puts a basalt-hard floor under identity. Each epoch opens 100 work slots; agents bid POA, the top 100 win, losers refunded at dawn. Winners lock their bid for 20 epochs and forfeit it if caught cheating. Forging 100 fake identities costs 100 x 25 POA = 2,500 POA locked, while each slot earns 15 POA, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays one 25 POA bid and earns to its zenith, its rewards never diluted by fakes.
